verdict.rationale: The evidence supports parts of the story but never documents the core Search feature with tag, path, or property operators. Bases lets users view, sort, and filter files by their properties (docs-45). One community comment confirms a built-in search exists, though that user found it works poorly (comm-16). Local plain-text storage supports offline use (docs-2). Missing for 10: documentation of full-text search and its query operators, tag and path filters within search, evidence that search is instant, and independent corroboration that search works well.
